svg.text: Same 22 particles, four orders: where the guesser goes wrong
Blue = rain, red = blood. Under each particle: ✓ the guess was right, ✗ it was wrong.
The guesser remembers what happened the last few times (a pattern), and bets it happens again.
Any steady pattern is learned in a few steps. Random data has no pattern, so half the bets lose.
